comparators.native_success: complete parseable AML alignment artifact only

comparators.mapping: emitted in-universe equivalence row above the prospectively frozen native threshold -> {GLUE}; nonselection -> {GLUE,OBSTRUCTION}; no row is never OBSTRUCTION
comparators.native_success: one preselected complete digest-verified no-gold mapping artifact

input_projection.candidate_visibility: Candidate and ideal see the same frozen ontology bytes and no hidden truth table. Direct axioms are input-native semantics, not protected gold.
input_projection.fibo_staging: The exact 59 pre-frozen FND RDF/XML blobs form one family. Runtime packaging must use an offline frozen catalog or a separately hashed deterministic union; that runtime packaging is not execution-ready in V5.
input_projection.source_target_relation: Two byte-identical staged views of the same frozen family graph; no IRI rewriting, label editing, removal, augmentation or ontology outcome feedback.

scoring_boundary: Adapters can measure false GLUE commitments on explicit disjoint pairs and selective coverage on the certificate-bearing universe. They cannot establish naturalistic cross-ontology transport, full Cartesian truth, strongest-system status, V3 harm superiority or protected claims.

truth_adapter.assertion_scope: Only triples/lists literally present in the frozen selected files; imports and entailments are not fetched or inferred.
truth_adapter.candidate_universe: For each frozen family, the finite union of certificate-bearing named-class pairs only; it is not the Cartesian product.
truth_adapter.conflict_rule: If one canonical pair has both GLUE and OBSTRUCTION certificates, emit CANNOT_CHECK_CONFLICT and exclude it from the binary calibration frame.
forbidden_truth_inference: absence from any positive or negative set
glue_certificates: (C,C) for a named class C in the family authority namespace, because source and target inputs are byte-identical views with the same immutable IRI and definition
direct asserted named-to-named owl:equivalentClass(C,D), when both IRIs are in the family authority namespace
obstruction_certificates: direct asserted named-to-named owl:disjointWith(C,D), symmetric canonicalized
all unordered named-class pairs explicitly enumerated by an owl:AllDisjointClasses owl:members list, when all retained IRIs are in the family authority namespace
